name: Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio (Trend-Filtered)
description: Long-only weekly-rebalanced portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Weights are inversely proportional to 20-day annualized realized volatility. A 200-day SMA trend filter excludes assets trading below their SMA — that allocation moves to cash. Rebalances at the start of each week.
source:
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio
# SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC — long-only, weekly rebalance
# Weights = 1/vol_i / sum(1/vol_j) using 20-day annualized vol

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Trend Filter ---
# 200-day SMA: only hold asset if price is above its SMA
sma_200 = ma(period=200)(close)
above_sma = is_valid(sma_200) and close > sma_200

# --- Volatility ---
# 20-day annualized historical volatility (close-to-close)
vol_20d = volatility(period=20)(close)

# --- Rebalance Schedule ---
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- Signal ---
# All 4 assets are always held (long-only, fully invested)
# Entry on first week boundary, never exit
# Hold asset only if vol is ready AND price is above 200-day SMA
# Assets below SMA get zero weight (allocation stays in cash)
always_long = is_valid(vol_20d) and above_sma
exit_signal = is_new_week and (not above_sma)
held = hold_until()(enter=is_new_week and always_long, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Inverse Volatility Weights ---
# w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) across active assets
weights = inv_vol_weight()(active_mask=held, volatility=vol_20d)

# --- Execution (wiring order: zone → sizing) ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
